# Third-party code kept in this repository

Single-file libraries the research kit compiles in, copied here so a build needs no network for them.

| Library | Version | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [stb_image](https://github.com/nothings/stb) | 2.29 | MIT or public domain (`stb/LICENSE`) | Reading PNG, JPEG, TGA, BMP and Radiance HDR images |
| [stb_image_write](https://github.com/nothings/stb) | 1.16 | MIT or public domain (`stb/LICENSE`) | Writing PNG captures and Radiance HDR captures |
| [cgltf](https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf) | 1.15 | MIT (`cgltf/LICENSE`) | Reading glTF 2.0 and GLB models |
